caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow plate with a wide rim, oriented directly facing the viewer. The central part of the plate features a decorative design consisting of a large stylized bird colored in yellow and brown, perched on a branch with multiple stems, leaves, and flowers in shades of brown, yellow, and green. The branch and plant motifs radiate outward, filling the central circle with organic shapes. Around the central image, on the plate’s border, there is an inscription written in a decorative script, following the curvature of the rim. The rim is also decorated with a pattern of alternating leaf shapes colored in tones of brown and green. The overall palette consists of soft earthy colors, predominantly yellow, brown, and green, with lighter areas representing highlights. The background around the plate is plain and beige, with no additional objects or markings except for a small signature with the text "E.H. Shellenberger 1/21/38" beneath the plate at the bottom right.
title: Pa. German Dish
